beta_context.definition: BTC-beta-neutral alpha context via the frozen 90d daily beta; BTCUSDT is benchmark-excluded (context-only, never a position)

funding_coverage.role: native funding while held (cost line only, never a signal input)

pit_clock.completed_bar_features: trailing-28d return uses the last completed 15m bar strictly before the stamp and the last completed bar strictly before stamp-28d; never a bar at or after the stamp
pit_clock.decision_clock: Mondays 00:00:00Z; features from completed 15m bars + last COMPLETED OI 5m row strictly before stamp; one declared execution lag after availability
pit_clock.execution_lag: one declared execution lag: fills at the open of the 15m bar covering the decision instant (first allowed execution event after availability; fill clock next_allowed_event_after_signal_bar_close)
pit_clock.oi_rule: the OI value used at a Monday 00:00:00Z stamp is the last COMPLETED 5m row strictly BEFORE the stamp; staleness > 48h marks the stamp UNAVAILABLE for that symbol (fail closed)

universe.eligibility_rule: PIT listing (>= 60d bar history), active (completed bar within 48h), 28d daily dollar-volume median strictly above the cross-sectional median of the active set
